en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a street scene with several people walking along a cobblestone road. To the right, there is a prominent building with a large dome, appearing to be a synagogue, set behind a fence with trees. The buildings along the street are two to three stories high, with classic European architectural elements. The text at the top left corner in German reads 'Mitau Bachstrasse mit Synagoge.'
